title: Juniper and the Witness
author: Lior Marchetti
blurb: Theo Zhou, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has spent twenty years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
